versions.changelog:
feishu-all-in-one v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Feishu All-in-One skill pack.
- Integrates four core capabilities: message sending/receiving, image/file upload, voice-to-text, interactive cards.
- Includes full setup and configuration guide for the Feishu Open Platform and OpenClaw.
- Provides scripts for sending messages, cards, and files, plus a callback server for interactive card handling.
- Fully tested and ready for out-of-the-box use.
